heading: Permanent debarment from participation in Department of Agriculture programs for fraud

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Subject to subsection (b), the Secretary of Agriculture shall permanently debar an individual, organization, corporation, or other entity convicted of a felony for knowingly defrauding the United States in connection with any program administered by the Department of Agriculture from any subsequent participation in Department of Agriculture programs.

children.heading: Secretary determination
children.text: The Secretary may reduce a debarment under subsection (a) to a period of not less than 10 years if the Secretary considers it appropriate.

children.heading: Food assistance
children.text: A debarment under subsection (a) shall not apply with respect to participation in domestic food assistance programs (as defined by the Secretary).

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Pub. L. 110–234 and Pub. L. 110–246 enacted identical sections. Pub. L. 110–234 was repealed by section 4(a) of Pub. L. 110–246.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Enactment of this section and repeal of Pub. L. 110–234 by Pub. L. 110–246 effective May 22, 2008, the date of enactment of Pub. L. 110–234, see section 4 of Pub. L. 110–246, set out as a note under section 8701 of this title.
